stories.title: Nvidia on track for longest weekly losing streak since 2012 as market value sinks by $1.6 trillion
stories.summary: Jensen Huang's resignation added to Nvidia's market woes, with the stock already in a downward slide since early October.

stories.zh_summary: 黃仁勳的辭職加劇了英偉達的市場困境，該股自 10 月初以來一直在下滑。

stories.title: Nvidia’s turmoil is prompting a rotation across chip stocks. Here's what we know
stories.summary: That shift comes as Nvidia grapples with the fallout from Huang's resignation, following revelations about his multiple affairs.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達的動盪正在引發晶片股的輪動。這是我們所知道的
stories.zh_summary: 這一轉變發生之際，英偉達正努力應對黃仁勳的辭職所帶來的影響，此前黃仁勳的多起婚外情被曝光。

stories.title: The bond market now has an even bigger fear than AI fallout

stories.zh_summary: 科技股的大屠殺使得美國國債在最近幾週看起來更具吸引力，但對聯準會進一步升息的擔憂正在推動收益率走高

stories.title: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
stories.summary: Google says its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model can give more helpful answers to complex questions, including "questions with multiple parts, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests." The new model can break down your questions and address each part in its responses. It's available starting today in search, the Gemini app, all tiers of Google […]

stories.zh_summary: 谷歌表示，其新的 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型可以為複雜的問題提供更有幫助的答案，包括「包含多個部分的問題、難以理解的拼寫錯誤或高度具體的請求」。新模型可以分解您的問題並解決其答案中的每個部分。开始可用

stories.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
stories.summary: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.
stories.zh_title: Nebius 計畫支出 400 億美元測試 Neocloud 策略
stories.zh_summary: Nebius 計劃透過客戶預付款和貸款為其 400 億美元的人工智慧基礎設施擴張提供資金，儘管微軟資料中心的延誤引發了對其融資模式的質疑。

stories.title: The S&P 500 is shrugging off Nvidia’s selloff this week. Here’s what’s keeping the rest of the market afloat.
stories.summary: Investors have been forced to look up from the poster child of the artificial-intelligence trade and remember the other stocks on the board.
stories.zh_title: 標準普爾 500 指數本週擺脫了英偉達拋售的影響。這就是讓市場其他部分保持運轉的原因。
stories.zh_summary: 投資人被迫從人工智慧交易的典範中抬起頭來，記住董事會上的其他股票。

stories.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
stories.summary: Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's AI Mode is getting better at understanding complex queries, surfacing relevant links, and delivering richer visual responses.
stories.zh_title: 谷歌最新的搜尋升級有望為您最複雜的問題提供更好的答案
stories.zh_summary: 在 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的支援下，Google 的 AI 模式更能理解複雜的查詢、顯示相關連結並提供更豐富的視覺回應。

stories.title: Google faces calls for AI moratoriums in schools after Gemini pilot backlash
stories.summary: Families confront Google after teen’s lawsuit labels Gemini a “suicide coach.”
stories.zh_title: 雙子座飛行員強烈反對後，Google面臨學校暫停人工智慧的呼籲
stories.zh_summary: 青少年訴訟稱雙子座為「自殺教練」後，家人與Google對峙。

stories.title: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
stories.summary: Jensen Huang’s resignation raises questions about Nvidia’s commitment to open source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition, open-weight models, and advocacy against restrictions, as the company navigates a leadership transition.
stories.zh_title: 黃仁勳的退出讓英偉達對開源的支持受到質疑
stories.zh_summary: 黃仁勳的辭職引發了人們對英偉達在領導層過渡期間對開源人工智慧的承諾的質疑，包括收購 Hugging Face、開放權重模型以及反對限制的倡議。

stories.title: AI chatbots are recommending fake retail websites, study finds
stories.summary: Shoppers using AI chatbots to research products or find places to buy items could be directed to imposters and other risky websites, a new study found. The study conducted by IP protection firm Podqi and shared exclusively with The Verge prompted ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity with a handful of shopping-related questions involving a selection of […]
stories.zh_title: 研究發現人工智慧聊天機器人正在推薦假零售網站
stories.zh_summary: 一項新研究發現，使用人工智慧聊天機器人研究產品或尋找購買地點的購物者可能會被引導至冒名頂替者和其他有風險的網站。這項由智慧財產權保護公司 Podqi 進行並與 The Verge 獨家分享的研究促使 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Perplexity 進行了一些研究

stories.title: I reviewed the Apple HomeView, ask me anything

stories.summary: Fed Chair Warsh’s quiet style of communicating interest-rate policy has led to more volatile markets.
